title: Loop spec
description: Every workflow the Flows page can draw, keyed by flow source. factory/lib/loops.json holds the one copy.

title.description: The loop's name on the page.

statusOnly.description: Makes the source status only. These are the words it may publish besides its title.

names.description: Regular expression for a trace title or a chip name that may stay.

subtitle.description: Regular expression for a subtitle that may stay.

fallbackTitle.description: Replaces a title that names does not allow.

fallbackSubtitle.description: Replaces a subtitle that subtitle does not allow.

stages.description: The phases in page order. The page always draws all of them.

edges.description: The ways the work can go back. An adapter supplies only a measured count for each.
